zh.title: 直布羅陀設立新航空器註冊處 採用VP-G國籍標誌
zh.summary: 根據AeroTime報導，英國海外領地直布羅陀於2026年8月4日與Aviation Registry Group簽署協議，設立專屬航空器註冊處，飛機註冊編號將使用VP-G前綴。該註冊處目前尚未開放營運，須先通過直布羅陀民航局稽核，預估飛機所有人可在2026年底前提出註冊申請。
body: 英國海外領地直布羅陀政府於2026年8月4日與專門從事航空服務的Aviation Registry Group簽署協議，正式設立該領地專屬的航空器註冊處。在該註冊處註冊的航空器，將獲得「VP-G」前綴作為國籍登記標誌。
該新成立的航空器註冊處目前尚未開放營運，未來須先通過直布羅陀民航局（GCAA）進行的稽核。直布羅陀民航局於2024年成立、2026年2月開始運作，並接受英國民航局（CAA）的監督。
管理機構規劃，航空器所有人可在2026年底前提出註冊申請。負責營運的Aviation Registry Group由David Colindres領導，目前同時管理阿魯巴與聖馬利諾的航空器註冊處。

en.title: Gibraltar Launches Aircraft Registry with VP-G Prefix
en.summary: According to AeroTime, the British overseas territory of Gibraltar signed an agreement on August 4, 2026, with Aviation Registry Group to launch its own aircraft registry, using the "VP-G" registration prefix. The new registry is not yet open for business and will require an audit by the Gibraltar Civil Aviation Authority, which operates under the supervision of the UK Civil Aviation Authority. Aircraft owners are expected to be able to apply for registration before the end of 2026. Aviation Registry Group also operates aircraft registries in Aruba and San Marino.
body: The British overseas territory of Gibraltar launched its own aircraft registry on August 4, 2026, following the signing of an agreement between the territorial government and Aviation Registry Group. Aircraft registered under the new registry will be assigned the "VP-G" registration prefix.

The new registry is not yet open for business and must first complete an audit conducted by the Gibraltar Civil Aviation Authority (GCAA). Established in 2024 and active since February 2026, the GCAA operates under the supervision of the United Kingdom Civil Aviation Authority (CAA).

Aircraft owners are expected to be eligible to apply for registration in Gibraltar before the end of 2026. Aviation Registry Group, headed by David Colindres, also manages the aircraft registries of Aruba and San Marino.
